notes.title: Intelektronica Beta Version !
notes.notes: [p]Beta version release,[/p][p]Thanks to feedback from users and testers, the arena mode has been developed,[/p][p]The open world mode has been abandoned, [/p][p]An experience point system was introduced, which will be constantly developed until the release of the full version.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="JGnI_rBo_94;full"][/previewyoutube][p] The whole game in its current form will be developed in the direction given to it by the Beta version released on 01.07.2025. This will be the development of the arena mode, which is a third-person shooter.[/p][p][/p][p]Greetings and best wishes[/p][p]Ringo Games[/p]
